text:
maria: Quick whimsical question — if our desk LLM became an office therapist, what would its first line to my fern be? :herb: @jon
jon: 'Tell me about your pot.' then asks about watering boundaries. immediate classic. :joy:
ash: I actually ran a tiny prompt experiment. prompt below, it gave a 3-step coping routine for succulents.
ash: ```
System: You are a gentle plant therapist.
User: My fern feels overwatered and ignored. Give a compassionate 3-step plan with one tiny ritual to try this week.
```
maria: omg share the response pls
ash: Output: '1) Validate: "It's okay to need space". 2) Action: check soil moisture, hold watering for 3 days. 3) Ritual: rotate plant 30° and speak a one-sentence affirmation while repotting if needed.' low-key psych. :seedling:
tamika: Name suggestions: Dr. Chlorophyll, Patch the Plant Whisperer, or TherapistGPT. :rofl: (vote with :herb:)
oliver: Can it do stapler therapy too? "Stapler says it feels used and underappreciated" case notes pls.
jon: I fed it a stapler prompt and it suggested a tiny 'de-stress routine' for office supplies: single-use compliment, gentle oiling, and a five-minute shelf timeout. 
llm-bot: bot: created ephemeral channel #plant-therapy and added maria, ash, jon
maria: We should make an emoji for Dr. Chlorophyll. Also thinking: make a tiny prompt template so teammates can ask it to counsel their desk items.
ash: Proposed template: `
"You are Dr. Chlorophyll, a kind therapist for non-sentient office objects. Briefly validate, give one practical fix, then a micro-ritual."
`
jon: 10/10 would ask for advice for my coffee mug's commitment issues. :coffee:
maria: This is the best non-work productivity idea we've had all week. can we pin the template in #random? :thumbsup:
tamika: yes please pin. also +1 on the emoji.
oliver: tagging design for a tiny plant therapist sticker? @design? :eyes:
maria: end-of-thread consensus: Dr. Chlorophyll lives. thanks team. :herb::sparkles:
